title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #5

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What group did Nicodemus belong to? (1 mark)
   A. The disciples
   B. The Romans
   C. The shepherds
   D. The Pharisees

2. What should you do when you sin? (1 mark)
   A. Blame others
   B. Confess, say sorry and put things right
   C. Hide it
   D. Repeat it

3. Why should we trust God always? (1 mark)
   A. He is far
   B. He is loving and faithful
   C. He forgets
   D. He is unknown

4. What did Bartimaeus call Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Son of David
   B. Master of the house
   C. Priest
   D. King of Egypt

5. Who was the one who returned? (1 mark)
   A. A Pharisee
   B. A Roman
   C. A priest
   D. A Samaritan

6. In which town did Zacchaeus live? (1 mark)
   A. Jericho
   B. Jerusalem
   C. Bethlehem
   D. Nazareth

7. Who chose your name in most families? (1 mark)
   A. Parents or guardians
   B. The police
   C. Your teacher
   D. A shopkeeper

8. How should people with contagious diseases be treated? (1 mark)
   A. By making fun of them
   B. With rejection
   C. With insults
   D. With care and respect

9. What did Jesus say to Zacchaeus? (1 mark)
   A. Come down, I must stay at your house today
   B. Follow me to Jerusalem
   C. Sell your house
   D. Go away

10. Which of these should you not share? (1 mark)
   A. A gospel song
   B. A Bible verse
   C. Private pictures of yourself
   D. A school notice

11. What can help you to build self-control? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping busy with good activities
   B. Ignoring rules
   C. Being idle
   D. Bad company

12. Which of these is a way of serving God in church? (1 mark)
   A. Talking during prayers
   B. Breaking chairs
   C. Leaving litter
   D. Helping to clean

13. What does the lost coin stand for? (1 mark)
   A. A lamp
   B. A person who has wandered from God
   C. A rich man
   D. A house

14. Where was Bartimaeus sitting when Jesus passed? (1 mark)
   A. On a boat
   B. By the roadside near Jericho
   C. In the temple
   D. At a market

15. How many fruits of the Spirit are listed? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Twelve
   C. Five
   D. Nine

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. State two ways of coping with anger. (2 marks)

17. State two lessons from the story of Stephen. (2 marks)

18. Explain why a Christian should behave well online even when nobody is watching. (3 marks)

19. Give two signs of a person with self-control. (2 marks)

20. Name two members of the extended family. (2 marks)

21. Explain the difference between the nuclear family and the extended family, with one example of each member. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — The Pharisees
   He was a Pharisee.

2. B — Confess, say sorry and put things right
   1 John 1:9 says God forgives those who confess.

3. B — He is loving and faithful
   God is reliable.

4. A — Son of David
   He called out, "Jesus, Son of David."

5. D — A Samaritan
   The one who returned was a Samaritan.

6. A — Jericho
   Luke 19:1 says Jesus was passing through Jericho.

7. A — Parents or guardians
   Parents or guardians usually give a child a name at birth.

8. D — With care and respect
   Jesus showed kindness to those with leprosy.

9. A — Come down, I must stay at your house today
   Luke 19:5 records Jesus asking to stay at his house.

10. C — Private pictures of yourself
   Never share private pictures.

11. A — Keeping busy with good activities
   Good activities help.

12. D — Helping to clean
   Cleaning is service.

13. B — A person who has wandered from God
   The coin stands for a lost person.

14. B — By the roadside near Jericho
   Mark 10:46 says he was by the roadside.

15. D — Nine
   There are nine.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Breathe deeply, count to ten, walk away, talk to a trusted adult, pray. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Be brave; forgive; trust God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: God sees everything; integrity means doing right in private; good behaviour protects us and others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Waits turn, controls anger, shares, saves money.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Grandfather, grandmother, uncle, aunt, cousin. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct member.

21. (4 marks)
   Answer: The nuclear family is parents and children living together, for example a mother. The extended family includes other relatives such as grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins, for example an uncle.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for describing nuclear, 1 for example, 1 for describing extended, 1 for example.
